verdict.rationale: Notte documents programmatic session management: sessions are isolated cloud browser instances controlled programmatically, started via API, and exposed over CDP for Playwright. For scale, the evidence offers only the marketing claim of "fast, scalable browsers", with nothing concrete on running many sessions in parallel. Missing for 10: documented concurrency limits or quotas, explicit fleet/parallel-session guidance, list/stop session-management API details, and independent corroboration of concurrent scale.
